assembly.staticModel: Ideal vertical flexible cords; choose outer prestress total3× upper weight to exhibit positive moment-balanced tensions. Illustrative feasibility, not a recommended physical tension or tested stability.
assembly.assemblySequence: Insert lower mast from above; upper mast from below. Support plates at separation; tie central lifting cord, then three perimeter stays. Level and remove temporary support. Optional glue at mast feet.
